reason: The answer citation grouping uses the CommonMark/GFM parser and its two GFM extensions already used transitively by Streamdown. Declaring mdast-util-from-markdown, mdast-util-gfm and micromark-extension-gfm directly makes those imports reproducible and preserves rendered-link semantics for escaped links, code, autolinks and scoped reference definitions. Existing unified is a processor, not a Markdown parser; regex parsing would disagree with the renderer. No second parser grammar is introduced.
